add_feature.definition: Recency-weighted qb_epa per dropback of the scheduled starter, from his own prior games (any team), strictly before pred week. w_g = 0.5**((g-1)/8), g most-recent-first. Cold start: >=4 prior games AND >=40 prior dropbacks else NaN.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: V1 has no QB identity; team EPA averages over who played. This isolates the scheduled starter's own record, including cross-team carryover.
add_feature.grain: team x pred_week (recency-weighted expanding history, min 4 games / 40 dropbacks)
add_feature.info_family: player-level value (starter skill vs team average)
add_feature.leakage_status: SAFE -- expanding history only, no future games; schedule-name quirks handled via documented deterministic aliases
add_feature.min_sample: 4 prior games AND 40 prior dropbacks; else NaN + qb_cold_start=1
add_feature.overlaps_v1: PARTIAL -- will correlate with team pass EPA (good QBs on good teams) but adds conditional info: identity-level skill, starter/backup replacement deltas. Kept per refined filter (correlation is priority, not exclusion).
add_feature.source: PBP 2018-2022 (qb_epa, qb_dropback, passer_player_name) + schedules home/away_qb_name (qb_sched identity). Built by scripts/37_v2_qb_value.py -> data/v2/qb_value_pred.parquet
add_feature.timestamp_availability: qb_sched is pregame-known per repo convention (script 33); all history strictly before pred week

add_feature.definition: Recency-weighted qb_epa per dropback on pass plays (sacks included) for the scheduled starter's prior history. Same weights/minimums as qb_value_historical.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: Separates the starter's passing efficiency from team passing EPA that mixes QBs.
add_feature.min_sample: 4 prior games AND 40 prior dropbacks; else NaN
add_feature.overlaps_v1: PARTIAL -- correlates with team pass EPA; conditional value is the identity split (starter vs team average).

add_feature.definition: Recency-weighted mean CPOE for the scheduled starter's prior history. CPOE defined on completions only (~81-82% of pass plays); denominator = completions.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: Accuracy skill is a QB trait team EPA does not isolate; priority-ranked 2nd under the refined filter.
add_feature.min_sample: 4 prior games AND 40 prior dropbacks; else NaN
add_feature.overlaps_v1: LOW -- accuracy-over-expectation is largely orthogonal to team EPA; partly flows into qb_epa (documented double-count caveat for composites).
add_feature.source: PBP 2018-2022 (cpoe column; verified nonnull on every complete_pass==1 play, all seasons). scripts/37_v2_qb_value.py

add_feature.definition: Recency-weighted sacks per dropback for the scheduled starter's prior history.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: QB-attributed sack rate separates passer decision-making from team pressure-allowed rates.
add_feature.min_sample: 4 prior games AND 40 prior dropbacks; else NaN
add_feature.overlaps_v1: MEDIUM -- partly OL-driven (team effect), partly QB decision trait.

add_feature.definition: Recency-weighted qb_epa per dropback on plays where the QB was hit (PBP qb_hit==1): pressure-response measure. NaN if no prior hit plays.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: Pressure response is a QB trait invisible to team EPA; priority-ranked 1st under the refined filter.
add_feature.min_sample: 4 prior games AND 40 prior dropbacks; else NaN (also NaN if zero prior hit plays)
add_feature.overlaps_v1: LOW -- most orthogonal component to team EPA; a QB-specific trait team averages wash out.
add_feature.source: PBP 2018-2022 (qb_hit 100% populated, ~13.8% of dropbacks; no per-play pressure indicator exists, this is the honest proxy). scripts/37_v2_qb_value.py

add_feature.definition: Recency-weighted QB rushing EPA (scrambles + designed runs, attributed via rusher_player_name) per team dropback, for the scheduled starter's prior history.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: Isolates the QB's own rushing value from team rushing EPA.
add_feature.min_sample: 4 prior games AND 40 prior dropbacks; else NaN
add_feature.overlaps_v1: MEDIUM -- scheme-dependent; rushing QBs concentrate value V1 spreads across the team.
add_feature.source: PBP 2018-2022 (rusher_player_name, qb_scramble; scrambles have NaN passer so rusher attribution is required). scripts/37_v2_qb_value.py

add_feature.definition: Recency-weighted PFR times_pressured_pct for the scheduled starter's prior history. TUESDAY-LAG RESTRICTED: PFR weekly advstats publish post-game; exclude from Tuesday-snapshot features (blocker 3). Friday-safe.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: Kept for completeness of the pressure picture; expected to overlap team pressure-allowed rates. Tuesday-lag restricted.
add_feature.leakage_status: MIXED -- walk-forward safe at week grain; TUESDAY-LAG RESTRICTED for production snapshots
add_feature.min_sample: 4 prior games AND 40 prior dropbacks; else NaN (also NaN if no PFR rows in history)
add_feature.overlaps_v1: MEDIUM-HIGH -- pressure rate is mostly OL/scheme, not QB skill; lowest priority as QB value.
add_feature.source: PFR advstats_week_pass 2018-2022 (100% populated; 98.95% team agreement with PBP). scripts/37_v2_qb_value.py
add_feature.timestamp_availability: strictly before pred week BUT subject to PFR publication lag -- not Tuesday-safe

add_feature.definition: Flag = 1 when the scheduled starter is below the cold-start minimum (<4 prior games or <40 prior dropbacks); all qb_* value components are NaN on these rows.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: Lets the modeling stage distinguish true missing (rookie/backup unknown) from measured replacement-level play.
add_feature.source: Derived in scripts/37_v2_qb_value.py from the same history.

add_feature.definition: Flag = 1 when the scheduled starter's most recent prior game was for a different team (mid-season/offseason move; his personal history traveled with him). NaN on cold-start rows.
add_feature.genuinely_new_rationale: Marks rows where the QB value mixes team contexts -- a modeling-stage interaction candidate (e.g. down-weight cross-team history).
add_feature.source: Derived in scripts/37_v2_qb_value.py (qb_team of most recent history game vs current team).
